decisions.decision: REFUTED + REVERTED: exposing ./collection.json (+ builders/executors/generators) in the package.json exports map is NOT the yarn fix.
decisions.rationale: Applied it (package.json + package-manifest.spec.ts), rebuilt, re-ran -> STILL failed identically. Angular CLI's SchematicEngineHost resolves the collection by FILESYSTEM-JOIN from the package dir (reads package.json.schematics then path.resolve(pkgDir, schematics)), NOT via the exports subpath; the real cause was the wrong version installed. Both edits were reverted to baseline exports {'.','./package.json'}.
